## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER candidate does not fire on any of the J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 5/05, 5/06, 5/07) and therefore captures zero edge on J days, as indicated by the leaderboard notes stating "Zero J anchor days affected". The mechanism relies on premarket bar breaks, which may not align with J's intraday entry timing.

## Mechanism

The candidate triggers on the first premarket bar that breaks the premarket low (for bear) or premarket high (for bull) and confirms with the first RTH bar. We ran the Stage-1 backtest via the grinder harness over the available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) and evaluated trigger occurrence on J anchor days.
